The '''Air-1 swoop''' was a type of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] that was built by [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]] and was presumably the predecessor design to the [[Air-2 racing swoop]]. One was used by the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], to attack the [[Heroes of Cularin]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
